from statsmodels.tsa.holtwinters import ExponentialSmoothing
from statsmodels.tsa.statespace.sarimax import SARIMAX
from statsmodels.tsa.forecasting.stl import STLForecast
import statsmodels.api as sm
from sklearn.metrics import mean_absolute_error, mean_squared_error

def forecast_model(y_train, steps, model):
    y_train = y_train.asfreq('MS')
    if model=='snaive':
        # forecast using last year same month
        idx = pd.date_range(y_train.index[-1]+pd.offsets.MonthBegin(1), periods=steps, freq='MS')
        return pd.Series([y_train.get(d-pd.DateOffset(years=1), y_train.mean()) for d in idx], index=idx)
    if model=='seasonal_mean':
        idx = pd.date_range(y_train.index[-1]+pd.offsets.MonthBegin(1), periods=steps, freq='MS')
        return pd.Series([y_train[y_train.index.month==d.month].tail(3).mean() for d in idx], index=idx)
    if model=='ets_add':
        fit=ExponentialSmoothing(y_train, trend=None, seasonal='add', seasonal_periods=12, initialization_method='estimated').fit(optimized=True)
        return fit.forecast(steps)
    if model=='ets_trend_add':
        fit=ExponentialSmoothing(y_train, trend='add', damped_trend=True, seasonal='add', seasonal_periods=12, initialization_method='estimated').fit(optimized=True)
        return fit.forecast(steps)
    if model=='stl_ar':
        fit=STLForecast(y_train, SARIMAX, model_kwargs={'order':(1,0,0), 'trend':'c', 'enforce_stationarity':False}, period=12).fit()
        return fit.forecast(steps)
    if model=='sarima':
        # fixed from best plausible
        fit=SARIMAX(y_train, order=(0,0,2), seasonal_order=(0,1,1,12), trend='c',
                    enforce_stationarity=False, enforce_invertibility=False).fit(disp=False)
        return fit.get_forecast(steps).predicted_mean
    if model=='ols_month':
        tmp=pd.DataFrame({'y': y_train})
        tmp['t']=np.arange(len(tmp))
        X=pd.get_dummies(pd.Index(tmp.index.month), prefix='m', drop_first=True, dtype=float)
        X.index=tmp.index
        X=pd.concat([tmp[['t']], X], axis=1)
        X=sm.add_constant(X, has_constant='add')
        fit=sm.OLS(tmp['y'], X).fit()
        idx=pd.date_range(y_train.index[-1]+pd.offsets.MonthBegin(1), periods=steps, freq='MS')
        fut=pd.DataFrame({'t':np.arange(len(tmp), len(tmp)+steps)}, index=idx)
        Xm=pd.get_dummies(pd.Index(idx.month), prefix='m', drop_first=True, dtype=float); Xm.index=idx
        FX=pd.concat([fut[['t']], Xm], axis=1)
        FX=sm.add_constant(FX, has_constant='add').reindex(columns=X.columns, fill_value=0)
        return fit.predict(FX)
models=['snaive','seasonal_mean','ets_add','ets_trend_add','stl_ar','sarima','ols_month']
